verified.label: Verified
verified.description: Multiple independent primary sources and/or physical/scientific corroboration with high confidence. Proof-grade within the domain of historical or scientific method.

well_attested.label: Well-Attested
well_attested.description: Strong primary or early secondary attestation with limited contrary evidence. Not multi-source physical proof, but historically robust.

circumstantial.label: Circumstantial
circumstantial.description: Indirect but coherent supporting evidence. Individual facts may be documented; the connection between them is inference.

contested.label: Contested / Scholarly Debate
contested.description: Significant disagreement among qualified specialists. Multiple positions are presented with evidence weights; consensus is not certainty.

interpretive.label: Interpretive Analysis
interpretive.description: Reasoned reconstruction that goes beyond raw data. Labeled as analysis, not as primary fact.

speculative.label: Speculative / Unverifiable
speculative.description: Hypothesis or tradition lacking sufficient primary or physical support for historical or scientific assertion.

literary_theological.label: Literary / Theological Development
literary_theological.description: Later interpretive, liturgical, or doctrinal elaboration. Never presented as historical or scientific fact.

verified.label: Verified
verified.note: Primary-source / multi-source documentation in Volume I sense.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.note: Volume I disputed ≈ scholarly Contested; some rows Speculative or Literary/Theological.
